title: Clarify NVENC tuning bundle choices
summary: Adds concrete descriptions for every EncodeTuningPreset choice in backend field metadata and shows those definitions below the Settings Video NVENC tuning dropdown.
reason: The NVENC tuning bundle dropdown labels do not explain which preset is balanced, slower/cleaner, faster, compatibility-focused, or raw legacy flag passthrough.
behavior_before: The Settings Video advanced encoder controls listed Balanced NVENC, Quality NVENC, Fast NVENC, Compatibility, and Custom legacy flags without visible per-choice meaning. Backend choice help was brief and did not name the practical flag differences.
behavior_after: The Settings Video advanced encoder controls show a compact definition list for all five NVENC tuning choices, and backend choice help explains lookahead, AQ, multipass, B-frame, compatibility, and raw ExtraVideoFlags behavior.
manual_validation: validate_changes --require-worktree-coverage - blocked by unrelated MP-CHANGE-2026-0605-010 missing date_completed; direct coverage helper reported 206/206 dirty paths covered
rollback_plan: Remove the Settings NVENC tuning definition list and CSS, restore the prior EncodeTuningPreset choice_help strings, and rerun the focused metadata/WebView Settings tests. No FFmpeg command behavior, persisted schema, or media files are changed.
notes:
Clarify every EncodeTuningPreset choice in backend metadata and visible Settings UI help without changing encode behavior.
Refreshed targeted generated summaries for changed Settings UI, metadata, tests, and packet.
